name: Mobilize
description: Mobilize is Bonterra's event-management and volunteer-recruitment platform for mission-driven organizations. Teams use it to publish public and private actions, recruit and communicate with supporters, manage event attendance, coordinate promoted events and connect organizing data to other systems.
agentUseSummary: Add a support-issued Mobilize API key and its exact numeric organization ID, then let selected agents use all 17 live or restricted v1 operations. Public reads run directly; private event, supporter and attendance reads plus every mutation require approval in Safe mode.

credentialRequirements.name: MOBILIZE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Mobilize API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Ask Mobilize to issue a dedicated key for the intended organization and approve the required read/write operations. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to api.mobilize.us as a bearer token.

credentialRequirements.name: MOBILIZE_ORGANIZATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mobilize organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact numeric organization ID authorized for the key. Relay substitutes it server-side into every private organization route and never accepts a runtime organization override.

capabilities.label: Read public organizing data
capabilities.description: List public organizations, list organizations promoted by the connected organization, fetch one public event without credentials and read current enum values.

capabilities.label: Read organization supporters and activity
capabilities.description: Read private-capable organization events, deleted events, supporter profiles and attendance records under Safe approval.

capabilities.label: Manage events and participation
capabilities.description: Create, replace or delete events; create signups and organization affiliations; and upload a bounded event image when Mobilize has approved those restricted routes.

allowed.label: Read public Mobilize data
allowed.description: Use four pinned public or non-sensitive v1 reads without exposing private supporter records.

approvalRequired.label: Read private Mobilize organization data
approvalRequired.description: Read private event details, supporter profiles or attendance records; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Mobilize
approvalRequired.description: Create, update or delete events, create signups or affiliations, or upload an event image; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Public reads run directly. Private supporter/event reads and all six mutations require approval, in addition to provider-granted restricted-route access.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 17 pinned operations run without Relay per-action approval; exact organization binding, provider authorization, supporter privacy, fixed routes, payload bounds, audits and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three approval-aware tools over all 17 live or restricted v1 operations with fixed origins, exact organization binding and encrypted customer credentials.
Relay mounts three approval-aware tools over all 17 live or restricted v1 operations with fixed origins, exact organization binding and encrypted customer credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: Mobilize must issue an API key for the exact customer organization and explicitly approve access to restricted event, attendance, affiliation and image-upload routes. Live acceptance additionally needs representative supporter/event data and authorization to exercise sensitive political or advocacy records in Railway staging.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized organization requests a dedicated least-privilege key and the six required restricted write routes from Mobilize, records its numeric organization ID, stores both through Relay Console, then validates exact-organization health, public credential omission, one approved private read, each approved mutation class, image bounds, provider rate limits, key replacement/deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: Mobilize's official v1 reference fixes the https://api.mobilize.us/v1 origin, bearer API-key authentication, JSON response envelope, cursor/page bounds, 15 read and 5 write requests per second, eleven live reads and six support-restricted mutations; Relay omits two deprecated global event-list routes.

Mobilize's current product updates continue to reference its public API, supporter opt-in fields, organization/event filters and current API behavior, confirming that the documented v1 surface remains active.

Mobilize documents the supporter identity, contact, ZIP and SMS-consent fields collected during event signup and shared with organizers, supporting critical-risk classification and approval-gated private reads and writes.
Mobilize's current terms identify the service as an EveryAction/NGP VAN product for mission-driven organizations to manage events and recruit volunteers.
Bonterra's current Mobilize privacy notice describes event, supporter, campaign and organization data, service-provider processing, retention and data-subject boundaries that Relay must preserve.
